title: Quick Fried Saudi Arabian Tahini Fritters
description: A delicious and easy to make Saudi Arabian dish featuring tahini, perfect for a midnight craving, these fritters are jammy and springy on the inside and crispy on the outside, served in an agave leaf vessel.

ingredients.name: Tahini
ingredients.notes: make sure it is well stirred

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the tahini, egg, and milk until smooth.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot in agave leaf vessels.
Garnish with a sprinkle of sugar and a drizzle of honey, if desired.
